Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Team Leader cum Civil Engineer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Team Leader cum Civil Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Team Leader cum Civil Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 109000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering with 12 years of experience is required. A Post Graduate Degree is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Team Leader cum Civil Engineer post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is IITG/II&SI/Project Staff Rectt-2026/149.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job.
